All clothing, shoes, soles, skin and accessories are fully opaque in their specified non-green colors: NO green apparel, green footwear, green reflections or translucent green body parts. Chroma green belongs only outside the character. Leave ample clear green padding around the whole subject. Use a solid clean ink silhouette, without a colored outline fringe. Accessories remain attached to the character; exactly one of each visible accessory.

# Comfy Fighter Z: complete game asset factory

1. Set the absolute root_directory on Asset Root. Fictional source definitions are generated from text; this demo loads no prior-session files.
2. Run the graph: 89 CLOUD image-generation nodes (paid Comfy credits). Each Save + Map node saves a stable raw PNG and its metadata.
3. The final exporter waits for ALL 89 mapped assets, then writes assets.json in that root, including descriptions, special moves and source mappings.
4. Open the Game Builder frontend, select that folder (assets.json + raw/), customize the roster/title, and export a playable directory or ZIP.

New source designs feed the anime identity references and stage; all sheets and cut-ins use those identities. Character descriptions and specialMove definitions drive the artwork. Audio has a separate cloud workflow writing audio.json into this root.

Install this project's comfyui/custom_nodes/comfy_fighter_assets pack into ComfyUI/custom_nodes and restart ComfyUI once. Only model nodes call cloud services; root/save/manifest nodes process local files. No model downloads. Running the graph spends credits; preparing it does not.
